explanation: Body falls under gravity with horizontal velocity toward thin vertical wall (w=0.3, x=14). At dt=0.0171 with 6 substeps, discrete collision detection/correction is insufficient for the curvature/trajectory near the top edge of the wall, allowing the circle to embed progressively: distance_to_surface goes from +0.098 at step22 to -0.051 at step23 to -0.200 at step24, exceeding 0.15 limit. Halving dt doubles collision sampling and prevents tunneling/penetration, confirming numerical resolution cause rather than intentional overlap.
vision_note: A red circular body descends vertically onto the top end of a thin vertical wall. From steps 21-23 it hovers just above the wall tip, then in step 24 it visibly clips into and overlaps the top of the wall.
